blocks.text: Summary

Product manager with 4 years across ride-sharing marketplaces, consumer mobile apps, and agriculture B2B. Grew two consumer apps past 5M downloads on Google Play, shipped driver payouts and an internal ERP that raised operations throughput 20%, and owned the acquisition systems for both sides of a marketplace. Works close to the code, writes specifications engineers can build from, and decides from analytics rather than opinion. Completing an MS in Management Information Systems in December 2026.
